items.hook: Bubblegum Crisis is a 1987-1991 Japanese cyberpunk original video animation (OVA) series produced by Youmex and animated by AIC and Artmic.
items.body: Set in the year 2032, seven years after a massive earthquake devastates Tokyo, the story centers on the reconstruction of the city under the influence of the megacorporation Genom, which mass-produces bio-organic androids called Boomers for labor and defense.
